facts.fact: The director of ANPFI says Burkina Faso's overall rate of use of financial services was 79.04% in 2023 and 81.8% at end-2025.
facts.system: Taux global d'utilisation des services financiers

facts.fact: The director of ANPFI says the overall rate of use of financial services passed the 75% first-strategy target at 79.04% in 2023 and stood at 81.8% at end-2025.
facts.system: Taux global d'utilisation des services financiers

note: The rate is an overall rate of use of financial services, not stated to be a survey of adults with accounts.
